Solana’s Alpenglow Upgrade Scheduled for October 21, Targets Finality Cut from 12.8 Seconds to 150ms Solana core developer Anza announced that the Alpenglow consensus upgrade is scheduled to go live on Solana mainnet-beta on October 21 at approximately 14:50 UTC. The upgrade will replace the existing TowerBFT consensus mechanism with Votor, aiming to reduce transaction finality from approximately 12.8 seconds to 150 milliseconds. Under the new mechanism, validators will exchange votes directly instead of submitting them as onchain transactions, potentially causing a significant decline in reported transaction totals that include validator votes. Alpenglow was previously activated on testnet on September 24 and devnet on September 25. — link

Coinbase, Which Holds About 5% of Existing BTC in Custody, Outlines Bitcoin Post-Quantum Security Recommendations Coinbase, which holds approximately 5% of all existing BTC in custody, outlined technical considerations for Bitcoin’s transition to post-quantum security. The company warned that the migration could take years and urged early preparations. Coinbase suggested exploring flexible output designs such as BIP-360 (P2MR) and P2TRv2, alongside a phased transition supporting both classical and post-quantum signature mechanisms. It also emphasized that questions surrounding dormant funds, lost private keys, and wallets that fail to migrate should be addressed separately to avoid delaying broader post-quantum security upgrades. — link

Philippine Crypto Giant Coins ph Faces Regulatory Scrutiny Over Alleged Gambling Links Coins ph, one of the Philippines' largest crypto exchanges with over 18 million registered users, is reportedly facing regulatory scrutiny from the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) over allegations that it facilitated transactions for restricted offshore gambling operators, potentially putting its license at risk. In late September, the BSP restricted incoming peso transfers to its e-wallet operator, DCPay Philippines, through InstaPay and PESONet. Several senior compliance executives have also reportedly departed. Indonesian tech giant Gojek acquired Coins ph for a reported $95 million in 2019 before selling it in 2022 to an investor group involving Joffre Capital and former Binance CFO Wei Zhou. — link

Polymarket CEO Renews Token Hints, Fuels Airdrop Speculation Polymarket CEO Shayne Coplan has again hinted at a potential token launch, fueling speculation over a possible airdrop as more crypto startups turn to equity financing. Polymarket, one of the world's largest prediction market platforms, has yet to announce a token launch plan. Speaking at TOKEN2049 in Singapore, Coplan said the company was exploring an on-chain asset with real programmable utility tied to its platform economy, but provided no launch timeline or details. — link
